verdict.rationale: Supabase ships first-party primitives for background automation. Supabase Cron schedules recurring jobs and monitors their runs inside Postgres. Database Webhooks fire on table events, Queues give durable guaranteed-delivery messaging, and Edge Functions run the server-side code. The agent-skills catalog also covers Cron and Queues, so an AI agent can set these up. Missing for 10: autonomous AI-agent-driven background runs (the AI assistant and MCP are interactive), hands-on or independent corroboration of the automation features, and in-depth evidence beyond single-line doc claims.
